title: Services accents Signal, Bloom and Iris: ship them once the owner allows their violet hexes

source.ref: LIVE-962 probe bars the violet band; Services Iris and the Signal and Bloom third glows fall in it

detail: The handoff's six accents include Iris (#7C6CF2 family) and third glows #8B7BFF (Signal) and #B57CFF (Bloom). violet-family.mjs allows violet per hex with an owner phrase (ADR-1885 pattern), and editing a probe needs Daniel's own phrase. Foundation shipped Tide, Ember and Fern. Closes by adding the three accents to themes.Services and SERVICES_ACCENTS after the phrase, batched into the single probe-pin ask with the other Services pins.
